dedupe_keys.name: latvian aerodrome runways runway centre line points and taxiways inspire air transport network data from latvijas gaisa satiksme

description: Latvijas gaisa satiksme, the state air navigation service provider, publishes aerodrome movement area data for Latvia under the INSPIRE transport networks theme on the ĢEOLatvija.lv platform. Contents: three products, namely runway areas, runway centre line points and taxiway areas, each with surface composition and element length and width, drawn from the aeronautical information the provider maintains for Latvian aerodromes with instrument procedures, including Riga International Airport. Producer: LGS, whose aeronautical information service publishes the Latvian AIP. Coverage: aerodromes in the Latvian AIP. Format and access: INSPIRE Atom feed downloads (GML) and WMS view services, open without registration. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0. Caveats: small datasets with geometry and a few attributes only; aprons, navigation aids and obstacles are not included; updates are irregular. Simulation uses: aerodrome layout inputs for airside capacity and disruption studies, flood and snow exposure of runways, and linking airports into national multimodal network models. Related records: the TEN-T network maps (data-eu-ten-t-network-tentec) list Riga as a core network airport.
